title: DataMaskCustomValueLibrary - Data API
description: Represents a set of user-inputted values in a custom library in Data Mask. This object is available in API version 64.0 and later.

ContentType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
ContentType.description: The type of value used in a field of the custom library. Possible values are: email number phone_number string url

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: The description of the value in the custom library.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Represents whether the library is active or inactive for use. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the custom library.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the custom library. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

Type.description: Represents how the values were added to the library. Possible values are: default user_defined

Values.description: The content of the value field for masking data.

special_access_rules:

associated_objects:
